chapter_summaries.summary: Kori Sato graduates the Academy and is placed on Team Aoi with Rei and Doro. The team runs its first D-rank missions and begins evening training in wind-nature control while Squad Leader Aoi weighs whether they are ready for harder work.
key_decisions: Advance: Focus training on a single reliable wind technique.
